content: {"episode_id":"ep-05070","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, which Cornerstone determined to be bundled and not separately payable. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), the note states that prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management. This distinct monitoring service was medically necessary as documented, and we request reconsideration of the outstanding balance of 297.40."}
